zh-CN.name: 错落入场
zh-CN.description: 元素按顺序淡入并位移，帮助用户感知内容的组织关系。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 三张卡片从下方 {offset_y_px}px 上移并从透明到不透明，持续 {duration_ms}ms，相邻延迟 {delay_ms}ms，使用 {easing} 缓动。重播前取消未完成动画；减少动态效果时直接显示最终状态。

en.name: Staggered Reveal
en.description: Elements fade and move in sequentially to communicate their organization.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Fade three cards from transparent to opaque while moving from {offset_y_px}px below the final position over {duration_ms}ms. Stagger by {delay_ms}ms with {easing} easing. Cancel unfinished animations before replay. Show the final state with reduced motion.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
